stem:
Subak is the irrigation system of the Balinese community that is closely tied to customary law (Hukum Adat). It not only unites agriculture with religious ritual, Subak also ensures that every part of Balinese society receives its “right” to water. Subak is also a real manifestation of the philosophy “Tri Hita Karana”, which means maintaining harmony in the relationship with God, among humans, and with nature. The Balinese people's obedience to ancestral tradition has let Subak survive from the 8th century to the present.

In the context of ‘the commons’, Subak belongs to…
stemId: Subak adalah sistem pengairan masyarakat Bali yang memiliki keterkaitan erat dengan Hukum Adat. Tidak hanya menyatukan pertanian dengan ritual keagamaan, subak memastikan seluruh unsur masyarakat Bali mendapatkan “haknya” atas air. Subak juga merupakan manifestasi nyata dari filosofi “Tri Hita Karana”, yang memiliki arti menjaga keharmonisan hubungan dengan Tuhan, antara manusia, dan dengan alam. Ketaatan masyarakat Bali pada tradisi leluhur membuat Subak bertahan dari abad ke-8 sampai masa kini. Dalam konteks ‘the commons’, Subak termasuk ke dalam…
note: The slides do not classify Subak into one of these four labels. They list the irrigation system among man-made commons (M4 s12) and traditional knowledge/culture as an intellectual commons (M4 s11); Subak is presented as a collective social-cultural institution (M4 s24). 'Intellectual' is the best fit by elimination, but 'biotic' (water, paddy) is arguable.

stem:
The Gersmehl Diagram depicts the dynamics of the nutrient cycle in 3 different biomes: taiga, tropical rainforest, and desert. In the diagram, nutrients are shown moving between forms: 1) litter (organic waste), 2) biomass (living things), and 3) soil. In the taiga, most nutrients are stored as litter because low temperatures inhibit decomposition and the transfer of nutrients to soil and biomass. In the tropical rainforest, most nutrients are stored as biomass because the consistently high temperature and rainfall speed up litter decomposition and litter is quickly absorbed by plant roots. In the desert, most nutrients are stored as soil because of the large amount of chemical and physical weathering, and the minimal plant formation caused by low rainfall.

The Gersmehl Diagram depicts one of the ecosystem services, namely…
stemId: Gersmehl Diagram menggambarkan dinamika siklus nutrien pada 3 bioma berbeda: taiga, hutan hujan tropis, dan gurun. Dalam diagram tersebut, nutrien digambarkan berpindah-pindah bentuk dari 1) litter (sampah organik), 2) biomass (makhluk hidup), dan 3) soil (tanah). Di taiga, kebanyakan nutrien disimpan sebagai litter karena suhu yang rendah menghambat pembusukan dan transfer nutrien ke soil dan biomass. Di hutan hujan tropis, kebanyakan nutrien disimpan sebagai biomass karena suhu dan curah hujan yang stabil tinggi mempercepat dekomposisi litter dan litter cepat diserap oleh akar-akar tumbuhan. Di gurun, kebanyakan nutrien disimpan sebagai soil karena banyaknya pelapukan kimia maupun fisika, serta minimnya pembentukan tumbuhan yang disebabkan oleh sedikitnya curah hujan. Gersmehl Diagram menggambarkan salah satu jasa ekosistem, yaitu…
note: The Gersmehl diagram itself is not in the slides; nutrient cycling is the standard MEA example of a supporting service, and the forest slide lists 'support energy flow and chemical cycling' (M4 s16).

stem:
The Amazon rainforest is the largest rainforest in the world. The Amazon forest is indeed a habitat for millions of animal and plant species, but its role goes beyond that. One of the roles of the Amazon forest is maintaining climate stability. This is achieved through the high density and amount of vegetation in the Amazon forest. The trees of the Amazon absorb a great deal of water. Through transpiration, these trees release about 20 tons of water vapor every day. This water vapor then forms clouds and produces rainfall that not only keeps the forest itself humid but also affects global weather patterns. If the Amazon forest disappears, the Earth will lose one of its largest rain suppliers and become increasingly hot.

stemId: Hutan Amazon adalah hutan hujan terluas di dunia. Hutan Amazon memang merupakan habitat bagi jutaan spesies hewan dan tumbuhan, tetapi peran keberadaannya lebih dari itu. Salah satu peran Hutan Amazon adalah menjaga kestabilan iklim. Hal ini terwujud melalui tingginya kepadatan dan jumlah vegetasi Hutan Amazon. Pohon-pohon di Hutan Amazon menyerap sangat banyak air. Melalui proses transpirasi, pohon-pohon tersebut mengeluarkan uap air hingga sekitar 20 ton setiap harinya. stem:
One application of carbon sequestration is Carbon Capture, Utilization, & Storage (CCUS). Arrange the following CCUS stages into the correct order!

| No. | Stage |
|---|---|
| 1 | Carbon is stored in very deep underground rock formations |
| 2 | Carbon is compressed and then transported by pipeline, ship, truck, etc. |
| 3 | ‘Capturing’ carbon from the air, for example by installing filters on the chimneys of manufacturing industries |

stem:
Look at the following thematic map!

Map (b) is a choropleth map of coal production, while map (c) is a choropleth map of coal consumption. How do the two maps relate to spillover effects?
options: Not all countries produce coal. There are also countries with high coal consumption but low coal production. This can indicate that those countries exploit coal from other countries. The exploited countries get “stress” in the form of environmental degradation, land conflict, etc. in order to meet the needs of other countries.

Both maps show that all countries that produce coal also have high consumption, indicating that each country meets its energy needs independently. "Stress" is experienced by the remaining countries that cannot meet their own energy needs.

Countries with low coal production show strong leadership in global climate-change mitigation. This indicates that these countries have successfully overcome dependence on coal and do not feel any “stress” in their territory.
answerText: Not all countries produce coal. There are also countries with high coal consumption but low coal production. This can indicate that those countries exploit coal from other countries. The exploited countries get “stress” in the form of environmental degradation, land conflict, etc. in order to meet the needs of other countries.
stemId:
Perhatikan peta tematik berikut!

Peta (b) adalah peta choropleth produksi batu bara, sedangkan peta (c) adalah peta choropleth konsumsi batu bara. Bagaimana kedua peta tersebut berhubungan dengan spillover effects?
optionsId: Tidak semua negara memproduksi batu bara. Ada pula negara dengan konsumsi batu bara tinggi, tetapi produksi batu bara rendah. Hal ini dapat mengindikasikan negara-negara tersebut mengeksploitasi batu bara dari negara lain. Negara yang dieksploitasi mendapatkan “stress” dalam bentuk degradasi lingkungan, konflik lahan, dan lain-lain demi memenuhi kebutuhan negara lain.

Kedua peta menunjukkan bahwa semua negara yang memproduksi batu bara juga memiliki tingkat konsumsi yang tinggi, mengindikasikan bahwa setiap negara memenuhi kebutuhan energinya secara mandiri. "Stress" dalam dialami oleh negara-negara sisanya yang tidak bisa memenuhi kebutuhan energinya sendiri.

Negara-negara dengan produksi batu bara yang rendah menunjukkan kepemimpinan yang kuat dalam mitigasi perubahan iklim global. Hal ini mengindikasikan bahwa negara-negara tersebut telah berhasil mengatasi ketergantungan terhadap batu bara dan tidak merasakan “stress” apa pun di wilayahnya.
answerTextId: Tidak semua negara memproduksi batu bara. Ada pula negara dengan konsumsi batu bara tinggi, tetapi produksi batu bara rendah. Hal ini dapat mengindikasikan negara-negara tersebut mengeksploitasi batu bara dari negara lain. Negara yang dieksploitasi mendapatkan “stress” dalam bentuk degradasi lingkungan, konflik lahan, dan lain-lain demi memenuhi kebutuhan negara lain.

stem: The concept of indivisibility in the SDGs means…

All SDG goals are interconnected and must be considered in an integrated way within a shared framework
